Arjunan M
Artificial Intelligence and Data Science Student
Madurai, Tamil Nadu

LinkedIn — GitHub — LeetCode
Profile
Final year B.Tech Artificial Intelligence and Data Science student at Mepco Schlenk Engineering College with strong
programming skills in Java, Python, C++, and SQL. Experienced in developing database-driven applications, client-
server systems, and machine learning solutions. Passionate about software development, backend engineering, and
solving real-world problems using efficient algorithms and scalable applications.
Education
Mepco Schlenk Engineering College, Sivakasi 2023 – 2027
Bachelor of Technology in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science
CGPA: 8.3
V.H.N Boys Higher Secondary School, Madurai 2021 – 2023
Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC)
Percentage: 94.3%
Technical Skills
Programming Languages
Java, Python, C++, C
Database
MySQL
Core Concepts
Data Structures and Algorithms, Object-Oriented Programming, Database Management Systems, Computer Net-
works, , Machine Learning
Projects
Hospital Finder Using GPS Location
- Developed a Flutter application integrating GPS and OpenStreetMap APIs to locate nearby multi-specialty hos-
pitals.
- Implemented real-time location tracking and optimized hospital search based on ratings.
Secure File Sharing System
- Built a client-server file sharing application supporting TCP, HTTP, and SFTP protocols.
- Implemented secure communication and reliable file transfer between multiple users.
Cryptocurrency Price Predictor
- Developed a Streamlit web application to predict cryptocurrency price trends using machine learning.
- Performed historical data analysis and visualization for improved prediction insights.
Voice Recognition System
- Developed a speaker recognition model using MFCC feature extraction and neural networks.
- Improved classification accuracy through audio preprocessing and feature engineering.
Text-to-SQL Interface
- Developed a Natural Language to SQL interface that converts user queries into SQL statements.
- Connected the application with MySQL to retrieve data dynamically.
- Simplified database interaction for non-technical users using Python-based query processing.
Achievements
- Finalist – Smart India Hackathon 2025
- Presented project at MepExpo’24
- Participated in National Level Hackathon conducted at SRM ITECH
Certifications
- Infosys Springboard – Python for Data Science
- Wipro FutureSkills – Cloud Computing
- NPTEL – Design and Implementation
- NPTEL – Industrial IoT 4.0
